name: Hello CSV Source
shortDescription: Generate a small synthetic patient-vitals CSV — a zero-dependency source for smoke-testing pipelines
description: Generates a configurable number of rows of synthetic patient vitals (id, name, age, heart rate, temperature) and writes them as a CSV to the artifact bucket. Needs no upstream input and no uploaded files, so it is the fastest way to smoke-test a fresh platform install: if this node builds and runs, the registry, Argo, STS credentials, and artifact storage all work.
